codeReview.summary: SessionsPage migration is largely complete and matches the feature contract: list search/sort/pagination, session detail rendering, tool event cards with collapsible payload sections, message limit selector, loading/error/empty states, and dedicated e2e coverage. One non-blocking implementation issue was found around unnecessary list refetching when selecting a session.

issues.description: `loadSessions` depends on `selectedSessionID`, and the list-loading effect depends on `loadSessions`; selecting/opening a session therefore retriggers a sessions-list API fetch unnecessarily, causing avoidable list reload/flicker and extra network traffic.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The frontend-worker skill procedure and mission guidance are partially misaligned: the skill asks to run full e2e and manual interactive verification, but mission guidance says full suite is known-failing for in-progress migration work and to run scoped specs. This can make `followedProcedure` ambiguous.
